description.default: Smart folder UX for parent docs: single-click expand/collapse, double-click to open, distinct folder icons, non-destructive directory overview cards, and right-click Copy Path for AI workflows.
description.zh-CN: 文档树目录增强：所有目录统一单击展开/折叠、双击（或 Option/Alt+单击）进入目录本身；区分 0 字纯目录与含正文父文档图标；打开空目录页自动渲染子文档卡片概览；右键一键复制可读路径/文档 ID。
